faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.text: Quick answers to what drivers ask us most.

items.question: Do I need an appointment?
items.answer: No. Just call before you come so we can plan the time for your car.

items.question: How long does it take?
items.answer: Usually between 1 and 3 hours, depending on the model and the car.

items.question: Do you remove the steering wheel?
items.answer: No. We stitch the leather cover on your steering wheel while it stays in the car.

items.question: Can I see the leather first?
items.answer: Yes. Come to the shop, look at the models and pick the one you like.
